title: Memory Copy
text: Copy data from and to memory section, 5 inputs, 1 output, {Termination value} sets Termination value; {Copy from} sets the input source for copy operation, {Specify address source} sets the source of memory address for input data Specify via, {Address} sets the memory address of source data hex2dec, {Source code symbol} sets the symbol in source code symbol table, {Data type}, {Data length} sets the number of data elements to copy, {Use offset when reading}, {Specify offset source} sets the source of input offset Specify, {Offset} sets the number of values to skip before copying first value, {Stride} sets the spacing for reading input, {Copy to} sets the type of output destination for copy operation Output, {Use offset when writing}, {Sample time} sets the rate of memory, {Set memory value at initialization} sets the memory address during initialization, {Specify initialization value source} sets the source of initialization value Specify constant, {Initialization value (constant)} sets the constant initialization value, {Initialization value (source code symbol)} sets the symbol in source code symbol table, {Apply initialization value as mask}, {Bitwise operator} sets the type of bitwise operation, {Set memory value at termination} sets the copy memory during program termination, {Set memory value only at initialization/termination} sets the copy memory value during program initialization and termination, {Insert custom code before memory write}, {Insert custom code after memory write} sets the custom code after memory write flag and {Custom code} sets the /* Custom Code Before Write*/ or /* Custom Code After. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Copy from
params.values: Input source for copy operation Input port (default) | Specified address | Specified source code symbol

params.name: Specify address source
params.values: Source of memory address for input data Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Address
params.values: Memory address of source data hex2dec(’00001000’) (default) | memory address in decimal or hexadecimal form with a conversion to decimal

params.name: Source code symbol
params.values: Symbol in source code symbol table myVariableSrc (default) | string | character vector

params.name: Data type
params.values: Data type of data being copied uint8 (default) | double | single | int8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 | boolean | Inherit from input port

params.name: Data length
params.values: Number of data elements to copy 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Use offset when reading
params.values: Use offset when reading input off (default) | on

params.name: Specify offset source
params.values: Source of input offset Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Offset
params.values: Number of values to skip before copying first value to destination 0 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Stride
params.values: Spacing for reading input 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Copy to
params.values: Type of output destination for copy operation Output port (default) | Specified address | Specified destination code symbol

params.name: Use offset when writing
params.values: Use offset when writing output off (default) | on

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Rate of memory copy inf (default) | scalar

params.values: Set memory address during initialization off (default) | on

params.values: Source of initialization value Specify constant value (default) | Specify source code symbol

params.name: Initialization value (constant)
params.values: Constant initialization value 1 (default) | scalar

params.values: Symbol in source code symbol table myInitValueVariable (default) | string | character vector

params.values: Apply initialization value as mask off (default) | on

params.name: Bitwise operator
params.values: Type of bitwise operation bitwise AND (default) | bitwise OR | bitwise exclusive OR | left shift | right shift

params.name: Set memory value at termination

params.name: Termination value
params.values: Termination value 1 (default) | scalar | vector | matrix

params.values: Copy memory value during program initialization and termination only off (default) | on
